## 7. Sequence 18

Sequence 18 is not a missing codex. The lattice list before the catalog (`LATTICE_URLS` in `client/scripts/build-lattice.js` at commit `0f0047d`) gave that number to `The-Evolution-of-the-Sovereign.pdf`, the series compilation. Compilation PDFs are not catalog entries. The other works kept their old numbers, so 18 stayed empty. It was already empty in the first committed catalog (134 entries, sequences 1–135). Nothing was added to fill it.
